tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search official Proa Rust framework documentation by a case-insensitive phrase. Use this to find current APIs, render patterns, RSJS guidance, and deployment instructions. Returns titles, routes, Markdown URLs, and a pagination cursor; call get_doc with a returned path for the complete page.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read a complete official Proa documentation page as Markdown with its title, description, and canonical route. Supply a path returned by search_docs or resources/list. Only published documentation is accessible; arbitrary URLs and filesystem paths are not fetched.
